profile.headline: Software Developer @ ASSET Intelligent Infrastructure
profile.summary:
Hi, I hope you're well. I'm a recent Computer Science graduate from the University of South Carolina Honors College, where I graduated Magna Cum Laude with minors in Data Science and Integrated Information Technology.
 
I'm passionate about building reliable software, collaborating in strong teams, and using data to solve problems. Right now I'm a software developer at ASSET, working in Python and Django across microservices, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. Beyond the code, I'm drawn to teaching and community: I've led technical workshops, instructed programming labs, and helped grow organizations that support and uplift others. I'm always looking to learn, create meaningful work, and connect with people solving hard problems.

Always happy to connect with people building interesting things!

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Django · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: MATLAB Student Ambassador
positions.description:
- Promoted campus awareness of MATLAB and Simulink through events and social media outreach
 - Led hands-on workshops on Data Visualization, Deep Learning, Machine Learning techniques, Simulink, Linear Algebra, and MATLAB onboarding, strengthening student proficiency
 - Grew the student reach through targeted marketing and social media posts, accruing 325+ Instagram followers and a 100+ subscriber email list
positions.insights: Skills: Simulink · MATLAB · Social Media Marketing · Event Planning · Public Speaking

positions.title: Lab Instructor for General Applications Programming Course
positions.locationName: Columbia, South Carolina Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
- Supplemented class lessons in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS fundamentals to 100+ undergraduate students through hands-on coding labs
-  Provided code reviews, debugging support, and clear explanations of core programming concepts, guiding students through UI design and troubleshooting
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Teaching · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description:
- Mentored students in a 550+ resident building through one-on-one conversations and peer support, building community and promoting student success
- Planned and hosted 2-3 monthly community-building events for residents, from large-scale floor programs to small-group socials
- Authored detailed incident reports documenting student interactions and policy violations to inform conduct-office case outcomes
 - Provided on-call support, resolving sensitive, time-critical situations

positions.title: Summer Resident Assistant
positions.description:
Managed 38 incoming freshman for the pilot year of the Summer Jump Ahead in Math program at USC
Provided peer mentorship, community-oriented events, and support to residents

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Automated and designed CI/CD pipelines with Python, Ansible, and GitHub Actions, cutting manual Splunk server deployment time by 90%
 - Collaborated with a 5-intern Agile DevOps team on the Monitoring, Observability, and Pipeline (MOP) team, managing weekly sprints and stakeholder deliverables
 - Wrote detailed, maintainable documentation for pipeline and deployment workflows to support future enhancements and audits
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Ansible · GitHub · Github Workflows

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Built and optimized a Random Forest model in MATLAB to predict CO₂ adsorption efficiency for carbon-capture research
 - Conducted Pearson correlation analysis to reduce multicollinearity and improve model reliability
 - Performed statistical analysis and linear regression to identify the key factors influencing carbon-capture efficiency
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · MATLAB · Microsoft Excel · Data Validation · Statistical Data Analysis

company.name: University of Tennessee-Oak Ridge Innovation Institute

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Researched lignocellulosic biomass particles using MATLAB image segmentation in the Biomass Engineering & Soil Science Lab and Center for Renewable Carbon
- Built a database of biomass particles and measured their physiochemical and particle-size properties
- Analyzed particle-size variance to support more efficient biofuel-plant processing

company.name: University of Tennessee-Oak Ridge Innovation Institute

positions.title: Barista
positions.description:
- Delivered high-quality service in a high-volume store, crafting beverages to standard while maintaining accuracy
- Resolved customer concerns using the Starbucks LATTE method (Listen, Acknowledge, Take action, Thank, Explain), turning service issues into positive experiences
- Collaborated with a fast-paced team to manage order flow, restocking, and store cleanliness during busy shifts
positions.insights: Skills: Food Service · Barista Training · Barista · Cashiering
